key: SOE Estimator (Energy Counting, Variable Energy Capacity)
title: SOE Estimator (Energy Counting, Variable Energy Capacity)
text: State of energy estimator with energy counting and variable energy capacity, 4 inputs, 1 output, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets Block sample time; {Specify Current input as cell current(s)} sets the option to specify current input port and {Algorithm data type} sets the option to choose data type for block algorithm. Values come from the instance.
